facts.fact: Rack Centre, a carrier-neutral data centre operator, runs a Lagos campus and announced an expansion to 6,000 sq m of white space and 13 MW; the document gives no opening date, so the as_of is its publication date.

Rack Centre states it was the first carrier-neutral data centre in the region to achieve Uptime Institute Tier III Certification of Constructed Facility; the document gives no date for the certification, so the as_of is its publication date.

note: carried from datacentres; no document opened
